[USER] User is looking for new seafood recipes to try out.  
[PREFERENCE] User is a beginner in cooking seafood.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Seafood is a wonderful world to explore!  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended beginner-friendly seafood recipes include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Garlic Shrimp: Marinate shrimp in garlic, olive oil, and lemon juice, then sauté until pink.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Baked Cod with Lemon and Herbs: Season cod fillets with salt, pepper, and herbs, and bake with lemon slices and butter.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Grilled Salmon with Asian-Glazed: Marinate salmon in soy sauce, honey, and ginger, then grill.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Seafood Paella: Cook Arborio rice with shrimp, mussels, clams, and chorizo in a tomato-based broth.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Crab Cakes with Remoulade Sauce: Mix crab meat with panko breadcrumbs, mayonnaise, and spices, shape into patties, and pan-fry.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Linguine with Clams: Cook linguine with clams, garlic, and white wine, then finish with parsley and lemon.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Cajun Shrimp Boil: Boil shrimp, potatoes, and corn in a broth with Cajun seasonings.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Tilapia Tacos with Avocado Salsa: Pan-fry tilapia with lime juice and cumin, then serve in tacos.  
[USER] User is interested in trying out the Seafood Paella recipe.  
[USER] User asks for tips on cooking the perfect paella, especially regarding cooking rice and seafood together.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for cooking the perfect paella include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Choose the right rice: Use Bomba or Calasparra rice for best results.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Rinse the rice to remove excess starch.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Use a 1:2 ratio of rice to liquid.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Cook rice over medium-low heat, stirring constantly until lightly toasted.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Add seafood in stages, starting with items that take longer to cook.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Layer ingredients for even cooking.
